name: Eric Schmitt

lean.basis: Republican senator from Missouri since 2023; as attorney general joined the suit to overturn the 2020 election (Texas v. Pennsylvania) and sued the Biden administration 25 times; openly backs national conservatism.

sources.title: Eric Schmitt — Wikipedia

source.title: File:Sen. Eric Schmitt, official portrait, 118th Congress.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: US senator from Missouri (Republican); vice chair of the Joint Economic Committee
summary: Eric Schmitt was Missouri treasurer and then attorney general (2019–2023), succeeding Josh Hawley, before winning a Senate seat in 2022. He openly embraces national conservatism: at NatCon 2025 he said it "is an idea whose time has arrived" and, in a speech titled "What is an American?", rejected the idea that America is defined by shared principles alone.
